positive_scope: Two complete layout method bodies match after explicitly enumerated platform/boundary/certificate adaptations.
All 144 inventory expression strings exactly match their original slot order.
Actual current core execution emits the same 48 facility requests and one drain request.
Every remaining original facility ID has a native mapping; this is map coverage, not native registry execution.
All five changed files retain complete ordered code, literal positions, comments and version directives.
limits: Original generate constructors/enabled/config hooks and native side effects are outside the two body-equivalence claims.
The streets-disabled global Random to per-chunk Random adaptation is explicitly different, not claimed output-equivalent.
Probe recorder rejects writes outside its chunk/height and returns air on reads; it is not a real Minecraft world.
Existing bootstrap inventory expectations invoke the same resolver; their source is not independent proof of full material, charge or enchantment semantics.
No Gradle/full-mod Java compile, GameTest, game, render, world restart, jar build, push or GitHub message.
